summary: Reconnaissance completed and a draft experiment plan is ready for review. AMD has a clean source clone at /work1/aviralkumar/geney/miles-ian, exactly 80a407b98a819add3e17383dc3238e3df9296f98. Dataset revision 8e486f2d980d926fa5543efe7f1f2adf475ce3ea has 2519 eligible questions and 385 protected questions (FOCS_2026=201, STOC_2026=184). Only the ten eligible Parquet shards were downloaded. They contain 1235 proof-writing and 1284 proof-strategy questions, 2283 labeled hard, and nonempty problems, answers, and 7-point prose rubrics. No exact normalized duplicate problem or answer exists within eligible data. Qwen4B tokenizer problem lengths are median574/p95=1032/max2026. All raw private examples and audit outputs remain under /home/ubuntu/.cache/miles/tcs-v3-recon/. The supplied command requires 16 GPUs and 16k context settings, and its external adaptive_rl hooks are absent. Its group reward hook accepts a list, while the generic llm_judge transport is per-sample; ordinary eval also rejects group-rm. The 4B checkpoint has tied embeddings and one MTP layer. ROCm tiled-head/MTP correctness and long-context training remain untested. Apptainer1.4.5 is available. Registry metadata verifies the Linux/amd64 Miles ROCm image digest sha256:25597c01ab3fc8e77bfeb48434262c535080dc6857c8d591165b4b9304425019, 19387976373 compressed bytes. It was not pulled or built. The example dated tag for20261016 is missing. Flame remains unavailable due to a changed SSH host key. No GPU jobs or paid judge calls were submitted. Solver budget meaning, thinking mode, resource caps, development split, reward contract, and writable GitHub destination require user decisions. Local records are committed, but pushes to the Ian origin fail authentication.
